clarification: The official Faculty of Business Administration and Economics inventory places Decision and Operation Technologies under Lehr- und Forschungsbereiche (teaching and research areas). It is not presented as an awarding department, doctoral programme or formal doctoral specialization. BiGSEM separately names its four actual Economics and Management doctoral profiles as Economics, Finance, Management and Data Science; none is a qualifying title. The grammatical singular in the area name is secondary, not the reason for exclusion.
effect: No new qualifying doctoral route; complete current named-title conclusion remains subject to the integrator's review of full unit and programme coverage.
